name: JTL Industries Ltd
title: JTL Industries Ltd - 534600 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 volume record 1,23,262 t (+47.5% YoY revenue) driven by Mangaon utilisation rising to 35-40%; FY27 volume guided ~30% growth with capex delays pushing the 2 mt capacity target and prior 6 lakh t FY27 outlook lower.

utilisation.quote: We are about 35%-40% range at our Mangaon facility.

capex.quote: There was some delay in the capex because of rains as well and a lot of multiple factors.

triggers.label: Capex delayed, FY27 outlook pushed
triggers.quote: So as the capex is delayed, the outlook is delayed as well.

triggers.label: Mangaon utilisation 35-40%
triggers.quote: We are about 35%-40% range at our Mangaon facility.

triggers.label: FY27 volume ~30% YoY
triggers.quote: it's safe to say that we'll be able to deliver about 30% volume growth Y-o-Y.

triggers.label: Discounts to push DFT
triggers.quote: some places we have to give discounts as well to push the product.

guidance.quote: it's safe to say that we'll be able to deliver about 30% volume growth Y-o-Y.
we should be touching somewhere close to INR4,500 to INR4,800 for this financial year.
that will result to a total utilization levels about 60%-70% for this year itself at the Mangaon facility.
we wish to aim a 15% export orientation.
we should be targeting close to INR150 crores to INR200 crores of top-line in the company.
the total plan for capex is close to INR100 crores and INR120 crores for this full financial year.
We should be drifting close to 25% to 30% ROCE for the next years

prior_guidance_check.quote: we were guiding for at 6 lakhs in FY27 and 9 lakhs in FY28.

prior_guidance_check.metric: 2 million tonne capacity by FY27 (exit 22.5 lakh t)
prior_guidance_check.quote: to reach a capacity of 2 million tons by FY27, yes, that's the intact target. That is still intact.

red_flags.label: Guidance slippage: FY27 6 lakh t outlook reduced to ~30% growth
red_flags.quote: So as the capex is delayed, the outlook is delayed as well.

red_flags.label: Inventory gains in defence margin
red_flags.quote: it's a lot of inventory gains in this quarter which happened as well

red_flags.label: Negative operating cash flow for 2-3 years, debt up
red_flags.quote: the last 2 to 3 years, we have been posting negative cash flow.

red_flags.label: DFT discounting to push new product
red_flags.quote: some places we have to give discounts as well to push the product.

evasions.topic: Q1 FY27 steel import pressure and EBITDA/t
evasions.quote: it's very tough to maintain a guidance to say that this will be a profit, this will be EBITDA per ton.
So to give you a number on that utilization is not what I can do at the moment.

evasions.topic: Q4 volume split between capacity, share gain and channel fill
evasions.quote: There was no inventory gain as such
